Short answer: yes, we can do a focused session on VPC/on-prem preflight and expected timelines. To make the demo practical, could you share:
- a ballpark of expected QPS or concurrent sessions for inference?
- whether you'd want a fully air-gapped on-prem POC or a VPC with secure peering
- any pre-existing compliance docs (SOC 2 / ISO) you need to see up front

Tentative times from our side:
- Wed Apr 14, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu Apr 15, 14:00–14:45 PT
- Mon Apr 19, 11:00–11:30 PT

Looping in Aditya from SDRs to coordinate the calendar and capture the intake details. If those slots don't work we'll open a few more.

Jordan / Aditya — thanks for the quick reply.

Answers inline:
- Expected steady-state: ~20 concurrent inference sessions, occasional spikes to 60 TPS for 30–45 minutes during batch windows.
- We prefer a VPC with private peering to start; air-gapped could be next phase.
- We've got SOC 2 Type II and a vendor security questionnaire we can share.

The Thu Apr 15 14:00 PT slot works for us. Please include a short agenda so we can invite the right folks. Also, we need to see SOC 2 evidence and a network-port checklist before the meeting.
